description: Interactive 3D particle UI built with Three.js — 18,000 particles that morph between 6 formations (Galaxy, DNA, Tornado, Heart, Sphere, Cube) with mouse interaction, bloom post-processing, and custom GLSL shaders
current_focus: Initial build — particle system with shape morphing
features_completed: Custom vertex/fragment shaders with simplex noise
6 particle formations (galaxy, dna, tornado, heart, sphere, cube)
Auto-rotating camera with drag orbit + scroll zoom
notes: First session — fresh project, going creative and wild with particles!
